name: vela-cli
description: Read-only Vela web inspector and CLI scaffold

scripts.postpack: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const path=require('node:path'); const pkg=require('./package.json'); const tarball=path.join(process.cwd(), `${pkg.name}-${pkg.version}.tgz`); const target=path.join(process.cwd(), 'dist', `${pkg.name}-${pkg.version}.tgz`); if (fs.existsSync(tarball) && tarball !== target) { if (fs.existsSync(target)) fs.rmSync(target, { force: true }); fs.renameSync(tarball, target); }"
